num_rows.description: Non-negative integer or `int32` scalar `tensor` giving the number of rows in the resulting matrix.

num_columns.description: Optional non-negative integer or `int32` scalar `tensor` giving the number of columns in the resulting matrix. Defaults to `num_rows`.

dtype.description: The type of element in the resulting `Tensor`.

output.description: A `SparseTensor` of shape [num_rows, num_columns] with ones along the diagonal.
